Welcome To Club House Hotel

The Club House Hotel is located at 138-142 Dubbo Street in Warren, New South Wales, Australia. Situated in the heart of the town, the hotel offers a welcoming and comfortable atmosphere for visitors and locals alike.

Office

138-142 Dubbo St warren NSW 2824 Australia

Restaurant & Bar
Menu

Breakfast Menu

  1. Traditional breakfast: bacon, eggs (cooked to your liking), sausages, tomato, and toast
  2. Vegetarian breakfast: grilled mushrooms, tomato, avocado, spinach, and poached eggs on sourdough toast
  3. Eggs Benedict: poached eggs, ham, and hollandaise sauce on an English muffin

Bar Menu

  1. Beer: a range of local and imported beers, including lagers, ales, and stouts
  2. Wine: a carefully curated selection of red, white, and sparkling wines from Australia and around the world
  3. Non-alcoholic beverages: a range of soft drinks, juices, and mocktails

Dinner Menu

  1. Chicken schnitzel: crispy chicken schnitzel served with your choice of sauce, salad, and fries
  2. Vegetarian pasta: creamy mushroom and spinach pasta served with garlic bread
  3. Seafood platter: a selection of fresh seafood, including prawns, oysters, and calamari, served with chips and salad

Indian Menu

  1. Butter chicken: tender chicken pieces cooked in a creamy tomato and butter sauce, served with rice and naan bread
  2. Chana masala: chickpeas cooked in a fragrant tomato-based sauce, served with rice and naan bread
  3. Vegetable korma: mixed vegetables cooked in a creamy and mildly spiced sauce, served with rice and naan bread
  4. Tandoori chicken: chicken marinated in spices and grilled in a tandoor oven, served with salad, rice, and naan bread
  5. Samosas: crispy pastry filled with spiced potatoes and peas, served with tamarind chutney

Thai Menu

  1. Pad Thai: stir-fried rice noodles with chicken or prawns, bean sprouts, peanuts, and egg
  2. Green curry: a spicy curry made with coconut milk, green chili, and a range of vegetables and proteins such as chicken, beef, or tofu
  3. Tom yum soup: a spicy and sour soup made with lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, chili, and your choice of protein
  4. Massaman curry: a mild and creamy curry made with coconut milk, potatoes, and your choice of protein
  5. Pad see ew: stir-fried flat rice noodles with your choice of protein, Chinese broccoli, and soy sauce
